summary: Lightwheel Inc. describes itself as a physical AI infrastructure company. Its EgoSuite page offers egocentric human demonstrations captured with a VR head-mounted multimodal unit, a custom exoskeleton system and a UMI-aligned gripper, with RGB-D, hand and body pose and tactile data. It claims 10,000+ tasks in 500+ environments across 7 countries and 300,000+ hours delivered. Access is by demo or early-access request; no price, turnaround, delivery formats, consent process or licence terms are published, and no terms pages are linked from the site.
